verdict.rationale: Lithic's Authorization Rules v2 explicitly support MCC-based allow/blocklists ('rules based on high-signal attributes like MCC') applied at program/account/card level, matching single-merchant lock via card-level rules, and rules run at authorization time via the ASA/auth stream integration. The MCP-server blog post also demonstrates configuring authorization rules controlling merchant categories in a live test flow. missing for 10: explicit documentation of a 'single merchant lock' feature by name and independent third-party confirmation beyond vendor docs.
